summary: Security gate PASS. 1 finding(s) scanned. 0 critical, 0 high. Finding SEC-001 marked FIXED after ownership check added.

findings.description: DELETE /tasks/{task_id} does not verify that the resource belongs to the current user before modifying or deleting it.
findings.evidence:
52 | @router.delete('/{task_id}')
   53 | async def delete_task(task_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
   54 |     task = db.query(Task).filter(Task.id == task_id).first()
   55 |     if not task:
   56 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
   57 |     if task.owner_id != current_user.id:
   58 |         raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail='Not authorized')
findings.recommendation: Fetch the resource first. Compare resource.owner_id with current_user.id. Raise HTTPException(status_code=403) if they differ.
